subject: privilege: handle username with "@" correctly for role(RBAC) related code (#59739)
summary: Reviewed this commit vs its parent, focused on privilege/RBAC role graph handling. The change replaces ambiguous string keys like `user+"@"+host` with `auth.RoleIdentity` struct keys for both `roleGraph` and edge tables, fixing collisions/splitting bugs when usernames/roles contain `@` (notably `SHOW GRANTS` role listing and role expansion during partial reload). Added an integration test covering `CREATE ROLE 'aa@bb'` + `SHOW GRANTS`. No Blocker/High correctness/privilege-boundary issues found in the touched logic, and upstream/master retains the same `auth.RoleIdentity` keying approach (no later revert/fix suggesting a hidden regression).
